data.description: The figure is a BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) graphical report for well ID Forge 56-32, located in the UTAHFORGE field. The BHA consists of three components: Heavy Weight Drill Pipe (HWDP), Drill Collar (DC), and Bit. The HWDP has a length of 731 feet and is positioned 763 feet from the top to the bit. The DC has a length of 31 feet, with an outer diameter of 6 inches, and is located 32 feet from the top to the bit. The Bit itself measures 1 foot in length and has an outer diameter of 8.750 inches, with a top thread specification of 4.5REG.
